title: What happened in LTO tape in September 2026
answer: LTO tape news for September 2026: shipped capacity rose 57% year on year in the first quarter after a 9% dip in 2025, 40 TB LTO-10 cartridges went on general sale for about $490 to $555, half-height LTO-10 drives have still not reached sellers, and LTO-9 media prices stayed flat while hard drive prices climbed.

items.headline: LTO shipments up 57% in the first quarter of 2026
items.summary: The LTO Program reported 160.3 EB of LTO capacity shipped in 2025, down 9% from the 176.5 EB record in 2024, and a 57% year-on-year rise in the first quarter of 2026, driven by LTO-9 adoption and the LTO-10 ramp. It expects 2026 to set a new record.

items.headline: Why 2025 dipped: tariffs and buyers waiting for LTO-10
items.summary: The Register quoted analyst Tom Coughlin linking the 2025 dip to caution over the international trade environment. Blocks and Files suggested buyers were waiting for LTO-10 and estimated 2026 could reach about 252 EB if the first-quarter pace holds.
items.source: The Register and Blocks and Files

items.headline: 40 TB LTO-10 cartridges on general sale
items.summary: The 40 TB LTO-10 cartridge, which uses an aramid base film and works in existing LTO-10 drives, is now listed by US sellers at $491 to $555, below the roughly $570 Symply had expected at launch. Fujifilm shipped first in January 2026 and IBM's cartridges followed in March.

items.headline: Still no half-height LTO-10 drive
items.summary: Symply had said half-height LTO-10 drives were expected in the second quarter of 2026, because full-height drives came first with a new head guide assembly. None was listed at any seller we checked in September, so LTO-10 remains a full-height, higher-cost option.
items.source: Symply support and TapeBackup.org price check

items.headline: Tape stays flat while hard drive prices rise
items.summary: DatacenterDisk reported LTO media largely stable at about $4 to $6 per TB while hard drive prices rose sharply in 2026, widening tape's cost advantage per terabyte from about 2 times to 3.5 times. Our own September check found LTO-9 cartridges flat against early 2026.

items.headline: Roadmap: LTO-11 planned at 70 TB
items.summary: The roadmap the LTO Program refreshed in November 2025 still stands: LTO-11 at 70 TB native and LTO-14 at 365 TB, lower targets than before in favour of reliability and cost per terabyte. No LTO-11 date has been announced.
